install.title: Install Python
install.win32: Download Python from python.org and tick “Add python.exe to PATH” in the installer. Then restart BluePy.
install.darwin: Download the macOS installer from python.org (not the Python that comes with the Xcode tools). Then restart BluePy.
install.linux: Install your distribution's python3 package (e.g. sudo apt install python3 python3-tk). Then restart BluePy.
